Project.title: Project
Project.description: A stickman dance project configuration representing a custom character stage, speech bubble, and beats settings.

id.description: The unique ID of the project

name.description: The custom name of the project

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp in Korean locale string format

faceImage.description: Base64 encoded string representing the face photo

faceScale.description: Scaling factor for the face image

faceOffsetY.description: Vertical offset in pixels for face placement

bgType.description: Whether to use preset or custom background

musicLink.description: Direct URL to online audio stream

musicFileName.description: The uploaded local music file name

musicFileData.description: Base64 data or blob URL of the uploaded local music file

speechText.description: The custom text for speech bubble annotations

speechColor.description: The background hex color of the speech balloon

danceSpeed.description: The multiplier for dancing speed and tempo

userId.description: The owner user ID under Firebase authentication
